content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to transfer a program to the SD card; I get an error stating, 'Failed to save as a *.bin file.' The program contains two text messages. I'm using a 64GB SD card formatted to exFAT (default). If I remove the text messages, the program transfers to the SD card successfully. Does anyone know what might be causing this issue?

Based on your diagram from [product_name] software, it appears you're using a [product_name] with [version_no]. These models only support SD cards up to 32GB capacity and require formatting as FAT32. If your SD card exceeds 32GB, you need to create a 32GB FAT32 partition. Free tools like "Mini Partition Tool Wizard" can assist with this.

Hi, I discovered the issue: the program couldn't be saved as a bin file because an open connector was missing after the text message block. After correcting this, I was able to save the bin file to my 64GB micro SD card without needing to reformat to FAT32.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a failure when attempting to save a program with text messages to an SD card due to a 'Failed to save as a *.bin file' error. The suspected causes included hardware compatibility and SD card formatting, but the main issue was a missing open connector in the program itself. The unclear error message made troubleshooting more difficult, and there was some uncertainty regarding the device's SD card size and formatting requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to transfer programs with text messages to SD cards seamlessly, regardless of card size or format, and desires clearer diagnostics indicating the exact cause of program save failures.
